2610.06318.title: Wiring Matters: Injection Topology and Initialization of Affordance Heads in Vision-Language-Action Policies
2610.06318.paper_summary: Dense affordance supervision is an appealing auxiliary signal for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, yet naively co-training an affordance head can severely damage instruction following. We present a controlled study of how to wire such a head into a modern VLA on the LIBERO benchmark. Our recipe reads the backbone through a stop-gradient and re-injects an intermediate head feature into the action expert via a learned bridge. The stop-gradient is a precondition: letting affordance gradients reach the backbone drops the policy below the headless base (85.5% vs. 93.1%). With the backbone protected, a same-budget 2*2 ablation over injection topology (concatenation vs. residual) and bridge initialization (zero vs. random) shows initialization is the dominant lever. The best wiring, an actively initialized residual bridge, reaches 96.2%, matching the far more elaborate three-expert AffordanceVLA (95.8%) with under 1% extra parameters. Two probes explain the mechanism: ground-truth affordances fed as an input hurt, and inference-time zeroing shows a lazy bridge acts only as a training-time regularizer while an active bridge becomes load-bearing.
2610.06318.paper_summary_zh: 密集的可供性監督對於視覺-語言-行動（VLA）策略來說是一個吸引人的輔助信號，然而，天真地共同訓練一個可供性頭可能會嚴重損害指令遵循。<lb/>我們在LIBERO基準上展示了如何將這樣的頭部接入現代VLA的受控研究。<lb/>我們的方案通過停止梯度讀取主幹，並通過學習的橋接將中間頭部特徵重新注入到行動專家中。<lb/>停止梯度是一個前提條件：讓可供性梯度達到主幹會使策略低於無頭基線（85.5%對93.1%）。<lb/>在保護主幹的情況下，對注入拓撲（串接對殘差）和橋接初始化（零對隨機）進行相同預算的2*2消融實驗顯示，初始化是主要的杠杆。<lb/>最佳的接線方式，即主動初始化的殘差橋，達到了96.2%，與更為複雜的三專家AffordanceVLA（95.8%）相匹配，且額外參數不足1%。<lb/>兩個探針解釋了這一機制：作為輸入的真實可供性會造成損害，而推理時的零化顯示懶惰的橋接僅作為訓練時的正則化器，而主動的橋接則成為承重結構。
